description: §19.16.5 — in a split function, a `defer` nested inside a top-level statement the split places on the SERVER (save: an `if` whose branch holds a `?{}`) is E-DEFER-SERVER-IN-SPLIT, exactly once — even though its deferred body (`@busy = false`) is client-tier: lowered there it would run inside the server batch and the client's @busy would stay true. A `defer` at the top level of a split function whose nested `if` stays client-side (other) is fine.
rationale: §19.16.5: a `defer` inside a server-side statement of a split function SHALL be rejected (fail closed) rather than lowered into the server batch.
